VolumeSnapshotService uses Foundation URL volumeTotalCapacity, available-capacity, locality, internal/read-only, and remount URL resource keys; it filters explicitly non-local volumes, deduplicates resolved mount paths, and reports inaccessible metadata as limitations.
VolumeCapacity clamps total and available byte values to a valid range and derives used = total - available. Fixture and live tests assert nonnegative totals and the capacity identity.
Snapshots sort volumes and limitations; exports use injected identifiers/timestamps, a fixed payload order, and JSONEncoder sortedKeys. The fixed fixture test exercises this deterministic path.
Generated storage-snapshot.json and manifest.json are validated by tests against Schemas/storage-snapshot-v1.schema.json and Schemas/export-manifest-v1.schema.json through the registered test helper.

SnapshotExporterTests recomputes SHA-256 and byte counts for each manifest-listed payload, checks privacy flags are false, verifies no environment payload exists, and confirms path traversal identifiers are rejected. Source inspection finds capacity metadata only and no file-content reads.
